== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Bantha Herd (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1230_24</code>, Virtual Block 3 slip 24), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-24-Bantha_Herd.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-D-banthaherd-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Bantha Herd (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip, drawn as icons. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on a Tatooine site. Once per turn, may place up to 3 cards from hand face down here. You may ‘react’ to battles initiated against your lone Tusken Raider by deploying (for free) any Tusken Raider(s) and/or Bantha(s) here. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1230_24</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 3 set mark, slip number as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB3-24-Bantha_Herd-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B06 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
